names.note: Name page 10110 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Иоанн Мервский, мч.»; the rank is stripped. The day line declines him as «Иоанна Мервского» and gives nothing else.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Иоанна Мервского.»

attestations.note: The day's seventh entry, and THE LINE IS ALL THERE IS: «Мч. Иоанна Мервского.» with no year, no life page behind it and no reading anywhere on the site that the day page links. Name page 10110 repeats the heading and nothing more. NO `dates`: the line gives no year and no century, and Merv, the city in what is now Turkmenistan, dates nobody by itself. No folder held him — `fk.mjs` on «Иоанн Мервский» returns NONE and no folder in this corpus carries «Мервский» in any form. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
